headline: Pending setlists are easier to spot and review on mobile.
highlights: Pending setlists appear on every church member's dashboard, with decisions limited to authorized reviewers.
Setlists show their submission date and pending age in the dashboard card.
The mobile dashboard has four priority shortcuts and more room beneath the bottom navigation.
On Android, Home, Events, and Library use saved content inside their normal layouts when offline.
Android downloads verified updates inside ServeSync and offers a separate Install update action.
